cells.normalized_text: Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 2 ↑3 seconds of each generates 2 Ammo to Magazine. Ammo Generation cannot generate ammo past Base Magazine Size. Timer between hits persists through stow.
Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2 ↑3 seconds of each generates 1 Ammo to Magazine. Ammo Generation cannot generate ammo past Base Magazine Size. Timer between hits persists through stow.

Reload Perk Notes: Generate = Grants Ammo to Magazine out of thin air, up to its Base Magazine Size. Does not work with Overflown Magazines. Overflow = Increases Base Magazine Capacity by a certain amount, rounded up. Refill = Reload, but does not have an animation and doesn't proc on-reload perks. Pulls from reserves on Special and Power Weapons. For Heat Weapons, it will instead be "Dissipates X Heat" to discern it from manual venting Reload = Procs on-reload perks. Manual Reload, Marksman's Dodge, and Dragon's Shadow all count as regular reloads. For Heat Weapons, finishing a manual vent will count as a regular reload.

source_behavior: Gap is between hits and persists while stowed.
Generate creates ammunition without consuming reserves, up to base magazine capacity; already overflown magazines receive no new rounds.
content_policies: Only APPLIED, explicitly weapon_damage + precision credited receipts qualify; explosive_perk_damage is excluded. Immune/blocked hits do not count. No positive-health-loss requirement is added.
Each perk, holder and weapon instance has independent state. Stow keeps the clock and in-flight credit; removing or changing the perk clears counters and receipts and cancels source-owned cleanup.
Each unique hit refreshes a half-open 2/3 second gap. Expiration at a timestamp occurs before a new hit. Body hits, misses and reloads do not reset or refresh this counter.
Every threshold consumes the count even when generation is clamped to zero. Both perks can trigger on the same hit; per-round base-capacity clamping is shared.

damage_id deduplication is retained for exactly three seconds per accepted hit, independent of counter resets. Scheduled forgetting bounds retained receipts to the recent window; replay after that window is outside this policy. This is not a gameplay cycle limit.

Counter/receipt state uses the perk binding at impact. Same-instance socket replacement in flight follows current equipment qualification. These boundary policies are Chorus choices pending independent D2 calibration.
